info.title: Slotify API
info.description: API documentation for Slotify booking system

post.summary: Process AI message and handle booking flow
post.description: Processes user messages through AI to extract booking intent, handle multi-step booking flow, and create bookings when all required information is collected. This endpoint is designed for n8n workflows and does not require authentication.

conversation_id.description: ID of the conversation this message belongs to

client_id.description: ID of the client sending the message

message.description: The user's message containing booking intent or information
message.example: I want to book a haircut for tomorrow at 3pm

force_booking_data.description: Optional object to force specific booking data, bypassing AI analysis

message_processed.description: Whether the message was successfully processed

ai_analysis.description: AI analysis results of the message

booking.description: Created booking details if booking was made
